It's a great opportunity for our kids to get involved, learn, and even present what they've prepared.

name: Reading Lab Volunteers Needed
description: The Reading Lab is a tutoring program for students who would benefit from extra help with fundamental reading skills. We are looking for volunteers who can come in once per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday) during the school year. Training for new tutors is provided!! Helping these new & growing readers is super fun and rewarding!

name: Castillero Athletic Booster Club
description: Attention 5th grade parents! Looking to get involved at Castillero? Consider joining the Castillero Athletic Booster Club (CABC) Board! The time commitment is very manageable and it is a great way to get involved at Castillero!

name: Castillero Music Booster Club Fundraiser
description: Support Our CMBC Program – Sweeten Easter & Mother's Day! We've partnered with See's Candies once again to bring you delicious, high-quality chocolates just in time for Easter and Mother's Day. All sales from this storefront will support instruments, sheet music, and performance opportunities for our students—and we'd love your support! Perfect for gifting (or treating yourself!), a sweet addition to Easter baskets, and a thoughtful way to celebrate moms, teachers, and the special people in our lives. Every purchase directly supports our young musicians and helps keep our music program strong.

name: Yearbook Update
description: If you haven't purchased the yearbook, please purchase it before April 20th. No yearbooks will be sold once they are distributed. The PTA would like to thank Sogol Jacks for being our yearbook lead for the last several years! She has done such an amazing job!! It's time for someone new to take over for next year. Are you creative? Maybe have an affinity for memory keeping or scrapbooking?! Please email losalamitoselementaryyearbook@gmail.com if you're interested! If we don't get a volunteer, we will have no yearbook!! Thanks in advance for volunteering!

name: PTA Board Member Elections
description: We are looking for members of our Los Alamitos community to join our PTA Executive Board for 2026-27 school year! If you're interested in getting involved, please email us or connect with any of our current board members. Below is our current slate for the 2026-2027 school year which will be voted on at our next general meeting on April 27th. If you are interested in joining the board, please email the PTA.
